title.narrative: A213. Facilitate access to market information platforms and ecommerce.

description.narrative: An assessment of existing digital market platforms, such as ecommerce, will be undertaken, to identify potential platforms to link small value chain actors to buyers. Such platforms facilitates the linkage between buyers and sellers of the value chain, by making available average prices from different areas, comparing them ,and advising on price setting for sellers. Buyers will have access to information on compliance to quality standards of the raw material, as well as on volume flows of sellers. Such platforms can also work to facilitate access to input financing. Selected farmer groups representatives will be trained on how to leverage tools such WhatsApp for business and social media (including professional Facebook Pages for sustainable agriculture practices and for improved market access. The use of innovative ICT to leverage finance for beneficiaries chains be explored.

title.narrative: A214. Facilitate access to financial services for small value chain actors

description.narrative: Meetings will be held with financial institutions (most likely Rural Banks and their Apex organizations) to identify those which might have already a portfolio of products and services for the selected value chains. Businesstobusiness meeting will be organized to present upgrade value chain business models and business plans to financial institutions, and training and coaching will be offered by the project, to strengthen existing financial products or develop new ones, more tailored on the need of farmers. Value chain financing schemes, with buyers engaged in the financial schemes, will be considered including resultbased financing schemes where farmers pay a portion of the irrigation system cost and private actors are contracted for the installation of the solar water pump and FAO verifies the installed irrigation system before issuing the payment of the balance. Support might be provided in partnering with existing fintechs as well as in the development of digital financial services. A collaboration with the Ghana IncentiveBased Risk Sharing System for Agricultural Lending will be explored, to provide Rural Banks with a partial credit guarantee. Partnership will also be explored with Mastercard Foundation and UNCDF, to develop specific credit lines with interest rates lower than the commercial ones (currently ranging around 2530% per year). Finally, a matching grant facility might be established, as a onetime grant for small value chain actors, to integrate partial loans of financial institutions along with the financial commitment of the client.

description.narrative: Rapid value chain (VC) assessments will be undertaken to identify weaknesses along value chain nodes and key barriers limiting access to markets for small actors of the VCs, especially small farmers and processors. Upgraded VC business model will be proposed, as a result of the assessment, to provide small farmers and processors with broader opportunities to sell to aggregators, larger processors, retailers, wholesalers and exporters.

description.narrative: The project will support small farmers and processors in improving their businesses in several areas, as identified under 6.1. Training will be provided to build small actors skills in business development and management.
